shellCommands.command: cat .agents/skills/gravity-ui/SKILL.md && echo ---- && ls -la && cat package.json && find . -path ./node_modules -prune -o -type f -print | grep -v '^./.git/' | head -50

head -80 .agents/skills/gravity-ui/references/package-routing.md && echo ---- && grep -n -i -C2 'dialog\|modal' .agents/skills/gravity-ui/references/package-routing.md | head -40 && echo ---- && cat .agents/skills/gravity-ui/rules/hallucination-traps.md && echo ---- && cat src/App.tsx src/main.tsx index.html && echo ---- && cat node_modules/@gravity-ui/uikit/package.json | grep '"version"' && ls node_modules/@gravity-ui/uikit/build/docs 2>/dev/null | head; ls node_modules/@gravity-ui/uikit/build/components/Dialog/ && echo ---- && cat node_modules/@gravity-ui/uikit/build/components/Dialog/Dialog.d.ts node_modules/@gravity-ui/uikit/build/components/Dialog/DialogFooter/DialogFooter.d.ts

ls node_modules/@gravity-ui/uikit/ && find node_modules/@gravity-ui/uikit -maxdepth 3 -type d -iname 'Dialog*' | head && f=$(find node_modules/@gravity-ui/uikit -name 'Dialog.d.ts' | head -1); echo "== $f"; cat "$f"; d=$(dirname "$f"); echo "== footer"; cat "$d"/DialogFooter/DialogFooter.d.ts 2>/dev/null; echo "== header"; cat "$d"/DialogHeader/DialogHeader.d.ts 2>/dev/null; echo "== body"; cat "$d"/DialogBody/DialogBody.d.ts 2>/dev/null; echo "== README"; cat "$d"/README.md 2>/dev/null | head -150
